There is a dining area with a fully equipped kitchen, full-size stove refrigerator, and microwave. Linens and towels are provided. A charcoal grill outside with a picnic table and two rocking chairs sit on the long covered porch. These square log cabins are next to the lake with great lake and mountain views from the porch, but no lake access due to the steepness of the terrain.
